RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel in engineering often reflects industry demographics, so it is not definitive proof of discrimination, though unconscious affinity bias remains a recognized risk. Group head roles heavily weigh commercial acumen and client management—areas where the successful candidate was specifically highlighted—rather than technical tenure alone.

Two weeks without feedback is poor practice, but you should follow up professionally on your feedback request first. Do not raise panel gender casually; doing so without evidence risks burning bridges. However, if their eventual explanation appears evasive, inconsistent, or discounts your objective qualifications without commercial justification, consult an employment advisor to evaluate whether a formal inquiry is appropriate.
